# Subway Seat for CSS variables

Every role as a custom property, with an -rgb triplet beside it for transparency. subway-seat-flavors.css holds all three, switched by data-theme or the system light/dark setting.

[CSS variables](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/Using_CSS_custom_properties) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/css/)

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |

| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.css`](subway-seat.css) | `your project, e.g. styles/subway-seat.css` |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.css`](subway-seat-tunnel.css) | `your project, e.g. styles/subway-seat-tunnel.css` |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in your stylesheet:

```css
@import url("subway-seat.css");

body {
  background: var(--ss-base);
  color: var(--ss-text);
}

.scrim {
  background: rgb(var(--ss-crust-rgb) / 0.8);
}
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in your stylesheet:

```css
@import url("subway-seat-tunnel.css");

body {
  background: var(--ss-base);
  color: var(--ss-text);
}

.scrim {
  background: rgb(var(--ss-crust-rgb) / 0.8);
}
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in your stylesheet:

```css
@import url("subway-seat-enamel.css");

body {
  background: var(--ss-base);
  color: var(--ss-text);
}

.scrim {
  background: rgb(var(--ss-crust-rgb) / 0.8);
}
```

- Delete `your project, e.g. styles/subway-seat-tunnel.css`.
- Delete `your project, e.g. styles/subway-seat-enamel.css`.
- Delete `your project, e.g. styles/subway-seat-flavors.css`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.
